target_polygon: Purdue BuildingShapesZip4 FID 218, WGS84 ring transformed with pyproj to EPSG:2968
roof_surface_filter: ASPRS class 1, points inside footprint eroded by 3 m
ground_filter: ASPRS class 2, points within 5 m external footprint buffer
tile_class_counts: Classes present: 1, 2, 7, 17, 18; no class-6 building returns.
interpretation: The central, eroded roof samples form a tight main-roof cluster. Upper-tail returns are outliers or raised objects and are not modeled as parapet/equipment. Three GIS levels are retained; floor spacing is derived, not observed.
raw_tile_policy: Large COPC is stored in work/jnsn and not included in the audit payload.
statistics_method: Median via NumPy; upper quantiles use nearest-rank ceil(p*n)-1.
